path.title: requires preservation of the joint law

g.title: The Yukawa template is phenomenological. Pure Palatini does not automatically supply a propagating vacuum scalar. Φ = −μ[1 + α exp(−r/λ)]/r
Dynamics uses the gradient of the potential. The derivative term changes the mass calibration. aᵣ = −μ[1 + α(1+x)e⁻ˣ]/r²
First-order precession retains the full eccentricity dependence through I₁(ex). Δϖ = 2πα √(1−e²) x e⁻ˣ I₁(ex)/e
Analytic formula, quadrature and a derivative of Cartesian orbital integration are compared. Bessel ↔ Gauss ↔ integration
Sensitivity conversion requires the same geometry, observable and refitting model. μdyn = μb [1 + α(1+xc)e⁻ˣᶜ]
A correctly calculated response does not demonstrate a new force. calculation ≠ detection

g.text: q ∼ N(b,K); pᵢ ∝ wᵢ exp(−c qᵢ)
g.title: A Gaussian vector on a finite grid induces a random law of normalized probabilities. q ∼ N(b,K); pᵢ ∝ wᵢ exp(−c qᵢ)
Log-ratios remove the common mode and retain the directions relevant to the posterior law. log(pᵢ/p₀) = log(wᵢ/w₀) − c(qᵢ−q₀)

g.text: Db = Db′; D K Dᵀ = D K′ Dᵀ
g.title: Equality of normalized laws is equivalent to retaining contrast means and covariances. Db = Db′; D K Dᵀ = D K′ Dᵀ
KL, Hellinger and Rényi quantify changes in law; equal diagonals are insufficient. DKL = 1.402585 nats
Contrast-law audit and, separately, a TV ≤ tanh(ω/4) bound for two posteriors on the grid. support → distance → decision
Marginal bands do not justify a joint law. This does not prove that a team sampled independently. marginal bands ≠ joint law
The analysis starts from 1696 reconstructed DSS-25 epochs and conditional design matrices. 1696 epochs · 20 passes
Nuisance parameters are marginalized with proper priors and four temporal covariance scales are compared. y = A s + Xβ + ε; ℓ ∈ {300,1800,7200,86400} s
The mixture favors the 1800 s scale under the fixed priors and reconstruction. P(ℓ = 1800 s | y) ≈ 0.986854
Aggregate improvement does not remove the local extreme in pass 12, June 24–25, 2002. pass 12: 0 / 1024 replicates
Blocked prediction localizes failures while retaining the lineage of weights and nuisance parameters. local prediction ≠ global evidence
Independent primary-data reduction and calibration of the full physical hierarchy remain outstanding. full SBC: pending
An information assessment must specify its target, prior and loss. θ ∼ π; L(θ,a); experiment E
Averaging, retaining a norm, truncating, censoring and transporting mass are distinct operations. Y → T(Y); J_T ≤ J_Y
The index normalizes Bayes-risk reduction relative to no observation, for a fixed decision. Kπ,L(E) = 1 − Rπ,L(E) / Rπ,L(∅)
A noise mixture loses information relative to observing its label. Risk respects the van Trees bound in the control. Jmixture = 0.345509 < Joracle = 0.555556
For a signed amplitude, the norm alone erases the sign; under a symmetric prior its posterior mean is zero. Z ∼ N(θu,I): J‖Z‖(0)=0; JZ=‖u‖²
Shannon, Rényi, Fisher and K answer different questions. Their assumptions and prior sensitivity must be reported. complementarity, not a universal score
DCAE distinguishes physical scale from observational access, with declared baseline and coordinates. LF > 0; LO > 0; baseline s₀
Logarithmic variation compares the scale ratio with its baseline. Δ = ln[(LF/LO)s / (LF/LO)s₀]
The positive-part index is always accompanied by the signed gap so contraction is not hidden. I₊ = 1 − exp[−max(0,Δ)]
The tables compare nearly equal coverage, but preference reverses with tolerance and observable. 89.8% / 90.0% → −9.0 / +23.4 pp
Observational geometry and inferential capability are evaluated separately for each observable. scale asymmetry ≠ inferential loss
Physical cosmological DCAE remains not estimable from these tables. NOT_ESTIMABLE
Gaia, QUMOND and other controls contribute different operator and covariance problems. local domains
Diagonal inflation can retain the common mode while altering orthogonal contrasts. Cshared ≠ Cdiagonal
The theoretical integral is reproduced for the specified external-field and interpolation scenario. Q₂ ≈ 3.38677 × 10⁻²⁶ s⁻²
A Fermi-LAT column shift is reproduced and event selections are rerun; software controls, not GR validation. records + SHA-256
AQUAL, QUMOND, TeVeS and AeST are not interchangeable actions; their tests require their own predictions. action → observable → test
The contribution is a reproducible statistical and physical assessment of conditional inferences. executable audit
